title.en: A woodblock behind Hiroshige’s fish prints
title.zh: 广重鱼类版画背后的木版

alt.en: A dark rectangular wooden printing block bears carved outlines of two fish, blossoms and rows of Japanese writing.
alt.zh: 深色长方形印刷木版上，刻着两条鱼、花朵与成行日文。

caption.en: Japan, c. 1840–1842. Woodblock for Utagawa Hiroshige’s design of olive halibut, black rockfish and cherry blossom, from the so-called Large Fish series.
caption.zh: 日本，约1840—1842年。用于歌川广重所谓《大鱼》系列中牙鲆、黑鲉与樱花图案的印刷木版。

interpretation.en: Carved fins, scales and lettering reveal the skilled work behind reproducible pictures. This surviving block is a tool used to make paper impressions. The museum credits Hiroshige with the design; its carver and printer remain unidentified.
interpretation.zh: 雕刻的鱼鳍、鳞片与文字展示可复制图像背后的技艺。这块留存木版是制作纸本印张的工具。馆方将图案归于广重，刻工与印工的身份未详。

items.creator: Design: Utagawa Hiroshige; block carver unidentified
items.institution: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution
